definition.def: You use predominantly to indicate which feature or quality is most noticeable in a situation.
examples: The landscape has remained predominantly rural in appearance.
Although it is predominantly a teenage problem, acne can occur in early childhood.
His audience consists predominantly of groups of rugby-club revellers.
